focus.title: 欧盟拟对中国电动汽车加征临时关税，中欧贸易摩擦升级引发供应链调整
focus.summary: 本周，欧盟委员会宣布拟对从中国进口的电动汽车加征最高38.1%的临时反补贴关税，理由是中国政府补贴导致不公平竞争。此举涉及比亚迪、吉利、上汽等主要车企，预计7月4日起实施。中方表示强烈反对，并考虑对进口自欧盟的猪肉、乳制品等发起反倾销调查。这一动向标志着中欧贸易摩擦从传统制造业向新能源领域延伸，出海企业需密切关注欧盟后续调查及关税豁免谈判进展，评估对供应链布局和定价策略的影响。
focus.source: 来源：欧盟委员会公告、商务部新闻发言人声明 · 本周
focus.title_en: EU Proposes Provisional Anti-Subsidy Tariffs on Chinese EVs, Escalating Trade Friction and Supply Chain Adjustments
focus.summary_en: This week, the European Commission announced plans to impose provisional countervailing duties of up to 38.1% on imported Chinese electric vehicles, citing unfair competition from state subsidies. The move targets major automakers including BYD, Geely, and SAIC, and is expected to take effect on July 4. China has strongly opposed the decision and is considering anti-dumping investigations into EU pork and dairy imports. This development signals an extension of EU-China trade friction from traditional manufacturing into the new energy sector. Overseas-bound enterprises should closely monitor the EU's follow-up investigation and tariff exemption negotiations, and assess impacts on supply chain layout and pricing strategies.
focus.source_en: Source: European Commission announcement, MOFCOM spokesperson statement · this week

case.title: 海牙上诉法院维持裁决，驳回印尼镍矿出口禁令案中投资者索赔请求
case.summary: 本周，海牙上诉法院维持了2023年的一审裁决，驳回了英国投资者基于《能源宪章条约》就印尼镍矿出口禁令提起的仲裁索赔。法院认定，印尼的出口限制措施属于主权国家资源管理权范畴，不构成非法征收。该案为资源国以环保或产业升级为由实施出口管制提供了国际法先例。出海企业特别是矿业、新能源上游企业需注意，资源国出口限制措施可能在国际仲裁中享有较大豁免空间，投资前应充分评估东道国政策风险并设计退出机制。
case.source: 来源：海牙上诉法院判决（2026年6月）
case.title_en: Hague Court of Appeal Upholds Ruling Dismissing Investor Claim Over Indonesia's Nickel Export Ban
case.summary_en: This week, the Hague Court of Appeal upheld a 2023 ruling dismissing an arbitration claim by British investors under the Energy Charter Treaty against Indonesia's nickel ore export ban. The court held that Indonesia's export restrictions fell within the sovereign right to regulate natural resources and did not constitute unlawful expropriation. The case sets an international law precedent for resource-rich countries imposing export controls on environmental or industrial upgrading grounds. Outbound enterprises, especially those in mining and new energy upstream sectors, should note that host countries' export restrictions may enjoy significant deference in international arbitration. Full assessment of policy risks and exit mechanisms is essential before investment.
case.source_en: Source: Hague Court of Appeal judgment (June 2026)

policy.title: 粤港澳大湾区跨境数据流动新规落地，简化企业个人信息出境合规流程
policy.summary: 本周，广东省互联网信息办公室发布《粤港澳大湾区（内地、香港、澳门）个人信息跨境流动标准合同实施指引》，明确大湾区内地九市与港澳之间的个人信息出境可适用标准合同，免除部分场景下的安全评估要求。新规适用于非敏感个人信息及一定数量以下的跨境传输，显著降低了金融、科技、医疗等行业的合规成本。企业需注意合同备案义务及接收方保护措施要求，同时关注香港、澳门本地数据保护法律的衔接问题。
policy.source: 来源：广东省互联网信息办公室 · 2026年6月发布
policy.title_en: New Cross-Border Data Flow Rules for Greater Bay Area Simplify Personal Information Transfer Compliance
policy.summary_en: This week, the Cyberspace Administration of Guangdong Province issued the Implementation Guidelines on Standard Contract for Cross-Border Transfer of Personal Information within the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area (Mainland, Hong Kong, Macao). The guidelines allow the use of standard contracts for personal information transfers between nine mainland cities in the GBA and Hong Kong/Macao, exempting certain scenarios from security assessment requirements. The new rules apply to non-sensitive personal information and transfers below specified volumes, significantly reducing compliance costs for industries such as finance, technology, and healthcare. Enterprises should note contract filing obligations and recipient protection measures, and pay attention to alignment with Hong Kong and Macao local data protection laws.
policy.source_en: Source: Cyberspace Administration of Guangdong Province · issued June 2026

analysis.title: 秦林蒿律师周度研判：出海企业应建立地缘政治风险预警机制，重点关注欧盟关税反制与供应链重构
analysis.summary: 本周，欧盟对华电动汽车加征临时关税及印尼镍矿案裁决，共同指向一个趋势：地缘政治与资源民族主义正深刻重塑全球贸易规则。出海企业面临的不再是单一市场准入问题，而是多法域合规叠加供应链安全的复合挑战。建议企业：1）建立国别风险评级模型，将出口管制、关税、投资审查等纳入常态化监测；2）对欧盟、东南亚等重点市场提前布局本地化产能或第三国转口路径；3）审查现有投资保护条约网络，评估用尽当地救济与仲裁可行性。下周关注：美国对华半导体出口管制新规动向、RCEP成员国原产地规则调整。
analysis.source: 来源：秦林蒿律师 · 本周
analysis.title_en: Attorney Qin's Weekly View: Outbound Enterprises Should Establish Geopolitical Risk Early Warning, Focus on EU Tariff Countermeasures and Supply Chain Restructuring
analysis.summary_en: This week, the EU's provisional tariffs on Chinese EVs and the Indonesia nickel case ruling point to a common trend: geopolitics and resource nationalism are profoundly reshaping global trade rules. Outbound enterprises now face not just single-market access issues, but the compound challenge of multi-jurisdictional compliance combined with supply chain security. Recommendations: 1) Establish a country risk rating model incorporating export controls, tariffs, and investment screening into routine monitoring; 2) For key markets like the EU and Southeast Asia, plan local capacity or third-country transshipment routes in advance; 3) Review existing investment protection treaty networks to assess exhaustion of local remedies and arbitration feasibility. Next week watch: New US semiconductor export control rules, and RCEP origin rule adjustments.
analysis.source_en: Source: Attorney Qin Linhao · this week
